summary.text: Cyndi Munson is the Democratic nominee for governor. She has represented Oklahoma House District 85 since 2015 and served as House Minority Leader from 2022; she was the first Asian American woman elected to the Oklahoma Legislature.

paragraphs.text: Raised in Lawton, Oklahoma; first in her family to earn a college degree, a B.A. in political science from the University of Central Oklahoma through the Oklahoma's Promise tuition program, and a master's degree from the University of Nebraska–Lincoln.
Worked in the nonprofit sector, including the OK Messages Project and Girl Scouts of Western Oklahoma, before winning a 2015 special election for House District 85.
Became House Minority Leader in 2022 and left the House as Minority Leader after the 2026 session.
